question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Mandatory
solution:
The correct answer is '**Optional**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate antonym of the given word '**Mandatory**' is '**Optional**'.
 
• **Mandatory**: required by a law or rule. (अनिवार्य)
 
 
• *Example: the **mandatory** retirement age...*
 
 
 
• **Optional**: that you can choose or not choose. [वैकल्पिक(जिसे आप चुन या छोड़ सकते हैं)]
 
 
• *Example: an **optional** subject at school...*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Optional.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Imperative**: very important or urgent. (बहुत महत्वपूर्ण या आवश्‍यक; अत्‍यावश्‍यक)
 
• **Requisite**: necessary for a particular purpose. (विशेष प्रयोजन के लिए आवश्‍यक या अपेक्षित)
 
• **Unavoidable**: that cannot be avoided or prevented. (जिससे बचना या जिसे रोकना संभव न हो; अपरिहार्य, अनिवार्य)
 
 

3a:T7cc,
The correct answer is *Option 1 (Scientists are looking for **alternative** energy to save **non-renewable** resources).*
